drafts.title: RP2040 bare-chip USB motor-controller core
drafts.summary: Real bareQFN RP2040,2MB Winbond QSPI,exact recommended12MHz crystal/internal1.1V regulator bypass,USB-C sink/ESD/27Ohm and BOOTSEL/RUN; AP2112K3.3V included. Known5V/1.5Asource; budgets/layout/USBimpedance/clockstartup unmeasured.

datasheet.note: Actual QFN56+GND57 pinmap. IOVDD1,10,22,33,42,49; DVDD23/50; ADC43,VREG_IN44,VREG_OUT45,USB46/47/48; TESTEN19ground. Core regulator default1.1V +/-3%,100mAmax; do not confuse150–450mA fault limit with guaranteed output. ADC26–29 and GPIOPWM functions are silicon facts, not a measured board.
